prediction_tasks.rule: The two horizons are evaluated separately. Do not combine them into one primary score.

primary_metric.name: multiclass_log_loss
primary_metric.reason: The model must provide useful probability distributions rather than only hard labels.

probability_adapter_for_deterministic_ba.purpose: Convert a deterministic baseline into a finite 15-class probability distribution without validation-set tuning.
probability_adapter_for_deterministic_ba.note: This is Laplace-smoothed calibration based only on the training partition for the corresponding horizon.

B0_persistence.probability_output: Use the frozen deterministic-baseline probability adapter estimated from the training partition separately for each horizon.
B0_persistence.role: Minimum temporal baseline. Any learned forecasting method must be interpreted relative to this strong persistence behavior.

B1_constant_motion.state: Use bomb XYZ at t and approximately one second earlier.
B1_constant_motion.velocity: Estimate recent 3D bomb displacement per second.
B1_constant_motion.projection: Project the bomb position forward by the requested horizon.
B1_constant_motion.projected_xyz_to_zone: Use an inference-only XYZ nearest-neighbor semantic resolver fitted on training-match player samples only, then apply the frozen 15-zone mapping.
B1_constant_motion.probability_output: Apply the deterministic-baseline probability adapter using B1 training accuracy for the corresponding horizon.
B1_constant_motion.leakage_rule: No target-match semantic samples may be used to fit the XYZ resolver.

B2_zone_markov.definition: Estimate P(target_macro_zone | current_macro_zone, horizon) from the training partition.
B2_zone_markov.smoothing: Add-one Dirichlet/Laplace smoothing over all 15 target classes.

B3_tabular_map_aware.rule: Feature set must use only information available at or before current time t.

rare_class_reporting.macro_f1_interpretation: Treat macro F1 cautiously when one or more zones have very small held-out support.

data_boundary.13_v2_reserves: Design/integrity evidence only. Do not use as V3 confirmation.
data_boundary.D_V3_DEV: Acquire and freeze a new chronological development corpus before baseline fitting and model selection.
data_boundary.D_V3_CONFIRM: Acquire and freeze separately only after V3 development decisions are complete.
